history.content:
I will remove aggregate/region entries and non-country records. Heuristic filters: exclude rows where Country Name contains parentheses or '&', and also exclude records with Country Code in known aggregate codes set. Then qualify countries with all years not-null and >35.

```python
import numpy as np
agg_codes = set(['AFE','AFW'])
df_countries = df[~df['Country Code'].isin(agg_codes)]
df_countries = df_countries[~df_countries['Country Name'].str.contains('\(|\&')]
years = [str(y) for y in range(2001,2011)]
def qualifies(row):
    vals = row[years]
    return vals.notnull().all() and (vals > 35).all()
qualified = df_countries[df_countries.apply(qualifies, axis=1)]
print(qualified['Country Name'].tolist()[:20])
print(len(qualified))
```
